description: This PHP file provides a web interface for managing Dynamic DNS (DDNS) settings on a network device, including toggling DDNS on/off, displaying existing DDNS services, and providing options to add, edit, or delete DDNS entries.

methods.name: add_service
methods.description: Function to add a new DDNS service; redirects to 'dynamic_dns_add.php' unless disabled or maxed out.
